answer: A Dedicated device bound by challenge-response signature with one identity per channel ties the identity to something the applicant actually controls: the dedicated device answers a fresh challenge, the challenge-response signature is recorded, and one identity per channel keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a Sybil farm would need a separate real channel for every fake account. A walnut that appears twice is the tell: the same channel cannot back two identities. After the hollow closes and the copper opens, the claim is frozen and published for audit.
